title: AC and heater controls
summary: Feedback centers on AC and heater performance, fan noise, and difficulty understanding or keeping climate-control settings, with many excerpts too brief or ambiguous to classify beyond mention of the feature.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor vent performance, fan noise above the lowest setting, and AC performance seen as weaker than competing vehicles.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention installed AC, slow heater response, confusing climate controls, and settings that do not stay locked, but the excerpts are too limited or inconsistently labeled for firmer sentiment interpretation.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a tighter sentiment reading.
Several fragments are very short or lack context, so specific causes and severity cannot be established.
The topic combines performance complaints with control-interface and setting-retention issues, which may reflect related but distinct subtopics.
